mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.sku_name, s.sku_code, s.price AS price, s.original_price AS original_price, s.stock, s.warning_stock, s.spec_attributes, s.sku_image, s.weight, s.volume, s.enabled, s.sort_weight, s.marketing_config, s.version, s.tenant_id, s.created_by, s.updated_by, s.created_time, s.updated_time, s.is_deleted, p.merchant_id AS merchant_id FROM product_skus s INNER JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.sort_weight DESC, s.created_time

SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.sku_name, s.sku_code, s.price AS price, s.original_price AS original_price, s.stock, s.warning_stock, s.spec_attributes, s.sku_image, s.weight, s.volume, s.enabled, s.sort_weight, s.marketing_config, s.version, s.tenant_id, s.created_by, s.updated_by, s.created_time, s.updated_time, s.is_deleted, p.merchant_id AS merchant_id FROM product_skus s INNER JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE s.id = #{skuId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0

SELECT p.id, p.merchant_id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name, p.description, p.type, CASE WHEN p.type = 'PHYSICAL' THEN '实物商品' WHEN p.type = 'SERVICE' THEN '服务商品' ELSE '未知类型' END AS type_desc, p.status, CASE WHEN p.status = 'DRAFT' THEN '草稿' WHEN p.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN '已发布' WHEN p.status = 'ARCHIVED' THEN '已归档' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_desc, p.tags, p.main_image, p.detail_images, p.detail_description, p.attributes, p.sort_weight AS product_sort_weight, COALESCE(sku_info.min_price, 0) AS min_price, COALESCE(sku_info.max_price, 0) AS max_price, COALESCE(sku_info.total_stock, 0) AS total_stock, COALESCE(sku_info.sku_count, 0) AS sku_count, p.created_by AS product_created_by, p.updated_by AS product_updated_by, p.created_time AS product_created_time, p.updated_time AS product_updated_time, p.is_deleted AS product_is_deleted, p.tenant_id AS product_tenant_id, p.version AS product_version, s.id AS sku_id, s.sku_name, s.sku_code, s.price, s.original_price, s.stock, s.warning_stock, s.spec_attributes, s.sku_image, s.weight, s.volume, s.marketing_config, s.enabled, CASE WHEN s.enabled = '1' THEN '启用' WHEN s.enabled = '0' THEN '禁用' ELSE '未知状态' END AS enabled_desc, s.sort_weight AS sku_sort_weight, s.created_by AS sku_created_by, s.updated_by AS sku_updated_by, s.created_time AS sku_created_time, s.updated_time AS sku_updated_time, s.is_deleted AS sku_is_deleted, s.tenant_id AS sku_tenant_id, s.version AS sku_version FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_categories c ON p.category_id = c.id INNER JOIN product_skus s ON s.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price, SUM(CASE WHEN stock = -1 THEN 999999 ELSE stock END) AS total_stock, COUNT(*) AS sku_count FROM product_skus WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY product_id ) sku_info ON p.id = sku_info.product_id WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND p.merchant_id = #{q.merchantId} AND p.id = #{q.productId} AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.name}, '%') AND p.status = #{q.status} AND s.enabled = #{q.skuEnabled} AND p.created_time >= #{q.createdStart} AND p.created_time <= #{q.createdEnd} ORDER BY p.updated_time DESC, s.sort_weight DESC, s.created_time

ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.enabled = '1' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price, SUM(CASE WHEN stock = -1 THEN 999999 ELSE stock END) AS total_stock, COUNT(*) AS sku_count FROM product_skus WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY product_id ) sku_info ON p.id = sku_info.product_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = mapper.update: UPDATE product_skus SET is_deleted = 1, updated_by = #{updateBy}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE product_skus SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (stock = -1 OR stock >= #{quantity})
UPDATE product_skus SET stock = CASE WHEN stock = -1 THEN -1 ELSE stock + #{quantity} END, version = version + 1, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT p.merchant_id FROM product_skus s INNER JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE s.id = #{skuId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(oi.id) FROM product_skus s INNER JOIN order_items oi ON s.id = oi.product_sku_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} AND s.is_deleted = 0

WITH sku AS (SELECT k.id, k.price, k.product_id, k.original_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.product_id ORDER BY k.price) AS rn
FROM product_skus AS k
WHERE k.is_deleted = 0 AND k.enabled = 1),
sales AS (SELECT product_sku_id, COUNT(id) AS sales_count FROM order_items GROUP BY product_sku_id)
SELECT spu.id AS spuId, spu.name AS productName, spu.tags AS tag, spu.main_image, sku.price, spu.category_id, sku.original_price, COALESCE(sales.sales_count, 0) AS salesCount
FROM (SELECT p.id, p.name, p.tags, p.main_image, p.category_id
FROM products AS p
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
ORDER BY p.sort_weight DESC LIMIT 10) AS spu
JOIN sku ON sku.product_id = spu.id AND sku.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN sales ON sales.product_sku_id = sku.id
